basic_profile.bio: I'm a skincare enthusiast living in Portland, Oregon. I've always been passionate about skincare, especially after struggling with acne during my teenage years. I spend a lot of my free time researching ingredients and trying out new products. My interests include reading detective novels, watching SVU reruns, and playing mobile games like MrAutofire. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to browse Reddit during my breaks. I'm in a long-term relationship and we both enjoy exploring the local food scene together.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a self-taught background in skincare, primarily through extensive online research and active participation in communities like SkincareAddiction. My knowledge has been supplemented by dermatology consultations and skincare webinars.
